```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(ape)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(ggnewscale)
library(tidytree)
library(ggstar)
library(gtable)
library(tidyr)
library(phytools)
library(beastio)
library(ggtree)
```

## Load and Visualize Gambia Global ML Tree

```{r load-tree}
# Define file paths 
tree_file <- "/Users/akanteh/Documents/backup11:08:2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetB/NewDataAnalysis/removingDuplicates/treetime/gambiaGlobalaligned.alnIQTREE.tree"
metadata_file <- "/Users/akanteh/Documents/backup11:08:2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetB/NewDataAnalysis/removingDuplicates/treetime/trait.txt"
output_file <- "/Users/akanteh/Documents/backup11:08:2022/phylodynamic_newAnalysis/cluster/gambianSamples/DatasetB/NewDataAnalysis/removingDuplicates/treetime/gambiaGlobalaligned.alnIQTREE.pdf"

# Read tree file
GambiaGlobalMLTree <- read.tree(tree_file)

# Load metadata and remove missing values
lineage_dat <- read.delim(metadata_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>% drop_na()

# Basic tree plot
p <- ggtree(GambiaGlobalMLTree) +
  theme_tree2()

# Add metadata visualization
p1 <- p %<+% lineage_dat +
  geom_tippoint(aes(colour = location), alpha = 0.5, size = 2.0) +
  scale_color_manual("Legend", values = c("#b300b3", "grey30"), na.value = "grey30") +
  theme(legend.position = 'right', legend.key.size = unit(0.5, 'cm'))

# Save the plot
if (dir.exists(dirname(output_file))) {
  ggsave(output_file, p1, width = 15, height = 15)
} else {
  message("Output directory does not exist. Please create it or check the file path.")
}
```
